channel.title: Social Media Today - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Social Media Today (socialmediatoday.com)

item.title: YouTube updates Payment Activity overview, provides more detailed data
item.description: The platform’s new capabilities include more detailed earnings and payout data to help creators better manage their AdSense accounts.

item.title: TikTok US users impacted by another problem at Oracle
item.description: Issues at a local data center in Ashburn, Virginia, led to more timeouts, errors and latency issues — and user speculation about government interference.

item.title: Snapchat report positions the app as a B2B marketing tool
item.description: New data released with GWI found that digitally native users are consuming business content outside of traditionally professional online environments.

item.title: xAI considers offering a free version of Grok Enterprise
item.description: The potential rollout would be available to companies with at least 50 employees, with the move suggesting that a paid business plan is on the horizon.

item.title: TikTok ad campaigns drive movie ticket purchases
item.description: Promotional performance in the app was significantly more effective than for traditional linear television advertising, according to new data from the company.

item.title: Meta says its AI-optimized data centers support the US economy
item.description: The company touted an uptick in construction jobs and infrastructure support, while also committing to the White House’s Ratepayer Protection Pledge.

item.title: Meta to let rival AI chatbots on WhatsApp in EU
item.description: The company was pressured into this concession by the EU Commission and is allowing competitors access in an effort to prevent regulatory proceedings.

item.title: Retail and grocery brands dominate ChatGPT ads
item.description: Since OpenAI began running ads four weeks ago, data tracked by Sensor Tower showed more than 100 individual brand promotions.

item.title: Meta faces UK and US investigations over AI smart glasses
item.description: According to multiple reports, the company’s contractors in Kenya are allegedly reviewing users’ private intimate content for training purposes.

item.title: X gets rid of its popular night mode in-app setting
item.description: According to Nikita Bier, X’s head of product, users will now need to change their device settings to activate the feature.
